<!-- Listing a platform? Keep the checklist. Anything else, delete it. -->

## Registry entry

- [ ] The file is `registry/<id>.json` and `id` matches the filename.
- [ ] `origin` is the scheme and host only, with no path.
- [ ] `reachability` is honest: `public` means the service document is served openly.
- [ ] I am connected to the platform I am listing.
